notes.title: The ASTRO SAGA New Chapter, "RANDOMAX" will be released on January 16!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36387283/f1bddf3860c38e6815fa7ff7cd4fca973b060e59.png[/img]
[b]Ride or drive the turbulent waves of luck toward victory![/b]
A novel rogue-lite vertical scrolling Shmup that puts your resourcefulness to the test!

A vast and random arsenal of misdelivered heavy weapons enter into your possession.
Find the most effective way to utilize them and turn the tides of battle in your favor!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3096420/

notes.title: "Graze Counter GM" WANTS you to play dangerously!
notes.content:
[previewyoutube=UdcxDrR-5Dw;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]A refreshing and highly re-playable bullet hell style shooter that WANTS you to play dangerously![/b]

"Graze" past enemy bullets to charge your "Graze Counter", then unleash it upon your enemies as a highly deadly attack! 
Ride the razor's edge of life and death in this high-risk high-reward danger oriented arcade style shooting game.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1486440/

notes.title: The ASTRO SAGA New Chapter, "Armored Lab Force VULVEHICLES"
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36387283/c9e71fb3c6c4378dc883f1fa3872084efa3400ce.png[/img]
Raze the road less traveled with your [b]Vulvehicle[/b], the ultimate all-purpose armored combat machine!
Whether flying through the sky or burrowing deep underground, these gals stop at nothing to blast through terrain and enemies alike in this comical action STG!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1957590

notes.title: Heavy weight Run 'n Gun mech shooter, "MECHBLAZE" is comming on Nov. 6th!!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/8894868/501b9bee82023eb3a351494a38c95bf10e02c05e.gif[/img]
An inferno roars over a destroyed secret military base.

Machine guns mow down wave after wave of advancing steel.
Pile Bunkers send deadly lances piercing through giant foes.
Then, from the flaming rubble...[b]an invincible super robot is reborn! [/b]

Super Mechs born of advanced science and modern weaponry battle in [b]heavy weight run-and-gun mech shooter!![/b]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1398500/MECHBLAZE/
